facts.fact: stepping frame_set 1..60 simulates the cloth into a memory cache that is not 'baked'
going back to frame 30 after stepping is a cache read, not a re-simulation
ptcache.bake_from_cache (with point_cache in the context) marks the stepped cache baked
bpy.ops.ptcache.bake without a point_cache in the context fails its poll in background mode
facts.error: Operator bpy.ops.ptcache.bake.poll() failed, context is incorrect

facts.fact: ptcache.bake with temp_override(point_cache=...) bakes headless and gives the same cloth as stepping
ptcache.bake_all(bake=True) needs no override and bakes every cache in the scene

jumping from frame 1 straight to frame 60 (nothing cached) takes ONE solver step stretched over the 59 frames: the free cloth falls metres, straight through the collider, nothing like the stepped result
facts.cache_info: 2 frames in memory (68 KiB), not exact since frame 1

facts.fact: a jump of 2 frames from the start is also taken as one step; a further jump after it does not simulate at all (the cloth shows the last simulated state)
facts.cache_info_at_3: 2 frames in memory (68 KiB), not exact since frame 1

facts.fact: points pinned at weight 1.0 do not move at all under gravity (default pin stiffness 1)
